syllabus.clause: put-if-absent commits of the next log version (historically needing a DynamoDB LogStore on S3, now viable with conditional writes); Delta's isolation levels (WriteSerializable default vs Serializable); catalog-managed tables (the successor to "coordinated commits"): preview in 4.0 (June 2025), with commits and then all table operations routed through the catalog in 4.2–4.3, laying the ground for multi-table transactions.
